items.title: Connected components pull back to unions of connected components under a field extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an extension of fields K/k and a scheme X over k, the inverse image of a connected component of X under the projection X_K to X is a union of connected components of X_K (statement lines 1103-1109). The author observes that the assertion is purely topological and then argues directly: for a point t of T_K and the connected component C of X_K containing it, the image p(C) is connected and meets T, so p(C) lies in T and therefore C lies in T_K (proof lines 1112-1117). The claim is H2: a short topological argument, with the only step beyond formality being the use that the connected component T is closed under the connected image p(C) once that image meets T.
